source_archive.name: R6E8A-HDF-minute-4-8Hz(1).csv
source_archive.note: 89 complete source rows precede 12:00 AM Detroit time on Apr 12 (20 commissioning minutes on Mar 5 and 69 Apr 11 ET minutes). They are excluded from the requested Apr 12 scope. None is 4-8 dominant, so the 4-8 numerator is unchanged while the analyzed-time denominator is corrected.

method.sustained_event: maximal consecutive complete 4-8-dominant minutes; primary threshold >=10 minutes

reconciliation.legacy_boundary_correction: The prior >=15 event export had the same 604/323/159 event counts but omitted the first complete 4-8 minute from five runs immediately after retrieval/gap boundaries. Rebuilding from the corrected minute sequence adds 5 minutes to >=15, 3 to >=30, and 2 to >=60 duration subtotals; counts do not change.

threshold_note: The >=10-minute threshold is a dashboard reporting/event-definition choice, not a medical, health, or legal exposure limit.
